articles.summary:

articles.title: NSA, CISA and NIST Release New Security Guidelines to Detect and Shut Down Rogue AI Agents
articles.summary:

articles.title: Hackers Exploit SiteGuard WAF Vulnerability That Could Give Them Full Control of Servers
articles.summary:
Hackers are exploiting a command injection flaw in SiteGuard Server Edition, a web application firewall installed directly on protected servers. Tracked as CVE-2026-106931, the vulnerability could let attackers run operating system commands with root or SYSTEM privileges, potentially giving them full control of an affected server. The flaw affects the product’s statistics function, which is […]

articles.title: Hackers Registered New Teams-Based Domains and Used a Login Page to Steal Your Logins
articles.summary:
A newly registered domain copies Microsoft Teams’ login page and interface, raising concerns about a phishing attempt targeting workplace users. articles.title: 16-Year-Old Broadcom Wi-Fi Flaw Lets Attackers Hack Routers Without Knowing Passwords
articles.summary:
A 16-year-old flaw in Broadcom’s Wi-Fi software can let attackers within wireless range take control of affected routers without knowing the network password. Security researcher Quentin Kaiser disclosed the issue at Hexacon in Paris on October 16, 2026, warning that old code remains in widely deployed devices.
